ewenecked: Having a neck like a ewe; -- said of horses in which the arch of the neck is deficent, being somewhat hollowed out. Youwatt.
ewery: An office or place of household service where the ewers were formerly kept. [Enq.] Parker.
ewe: The female of the sheep, and of sheeplike animals.
ewry: An office or place of household service where the ewers were formerly kept. [Enq.] Parker.
ewer: A kind of widemouthed pitcher or jug; esp., one used to hold water for the toilet. Basins and ewers to lave her dainty hands. Shak.
